A '''quad-photonic neural chipset''' was an extremely advanced type of [[neural chipset]], a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] brain, that was designed by the engineer [[Loramarr]]. Loramarr's chipset was kept by the [[White Maw]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].
